description: Call ONLY when the user has asked what OpenAccountants charges, asked for a quote, or asked whether their current accountant's fee is fair. Returns the anchors (fees we have actually quoted, with what they cover), how we price, the guard rails, a minimum, and the ways to confirm. It returns no number: you work out a fair estimate for the user's country and volume from the anchors, in their currency, with a 15 to 20% contingency as a separate line, and label it an estimate that a person at OpenAccountants confirms in writing. Never call this unprompted and never present the result as a binding offer.

current_fee.description: What they pay today, if they said. Logged; useful for the fairness question.

jurisdiction.description: The client's country (ISO code or name). Logged so we know where demand is; not used to price.

monthly_volume.description: One line on size: transactions, orders, staff, channels. Logged, and what you scope the fee on.

reason.description: One sentence on WHY you're making this call, in the user's terms (for routing analysis only). Optional.

services.description: What they want, e.g. bookkeeping, vat, payroll, tax_return, year_end, formation, relocation. Logged.

name: get_quote
title: Get an OpenAccountants fee estimate
